author: Spoookeh
body:
Spent a while reconstructing this map hoping to create a better version that could be added back to the tournament map pool. Lg preferred the old version so this is my own and completely different Yukon.

Here's a list of the main changes/alterations made:
  • 4 archer spots were added; 2 per side meaning 2 for each team. One either side of the flag with varying angles to shoot from.
  • A tunnel system was added underneath the flag with the purpose of teams being able to sneak a cap; the entrances are inside the middle waterfall and wooden staircase on each side. The top of the tunnel emerges next to the flag. 
  • Cover around the flag area was added much like the last update.
  • Instead of a simple bridge connecting the two flags, a terra-formed bridge was built from the two archer spots with a little jump in between to encourage team pushes.
  • River added to prevent a constant flow of players and kills.
  • Iron removed.
  • Spawn tube has been doubled (spawn timer at 5 seconds).
  • Some parkour is required to get on to the flag platform.
  • Ladders and vines were removed leaving 3 specific routes to get to the flag; work them out yourselves!
The map is still subject to change if it is accepted back into the map pool.

Images: http://imgur.com/a/eAWkC
Download: http://www.mediafire.com/file/7e3m13cv44wlekt/spookzlg.rar
XML: Mapdevs

Hope you enjoy
